scenarios.name: Cancel inserting a model-state table row

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State in that order
Capture State has extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in
the user opens the context menu on the Capture State row number
Insert Row and Delete Row are available
the default-row, parameter-range and column commands appear disabled
a generated member row appears immediately after Capture State
the new row shows extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in
the user cancels and reopens the table
only the original three member rows are shown in their original order
